spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact dictionary member (datagramsReadableType) via synchronous conversion, and cross-checks with the WebIDL enum rule that only "bytes" is a legal ReadableStreamType value.

interactive.rationale: Run-the-roll-call and invalid-value buttons both perform real constructions; results render per-member cards and a trust verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a bracketed roll-call plus the invalid-enum TypeError check; the page is exactly those two panels.

edge_cases.rationale: Controls are self-invalidating (a wrong control voids the verdict); build iteration found and fixed a real control bug — allowPooling is NOT converted by older Chromium, so the must-fire control is serverCertificateHashes, and the page copy now records that trap.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5148774971342848, the spec member, and WebIDL enumeration conversion.

conformance.rationale: New 7-assertion feature suite mirrors the page (getter-observed conversion, bytes-grants-BYOB, default-refuses-BYOB, default reader availability, invalid-enum TypeError, plus an honest manual empty-datagram assertion); executes 3 pass / 3 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141 — the two fails documenting the legacy byte-stream state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session), re-driven AFTER the final edit: roll-call controlsHold=true (serverCertificateHashes read, subject and invented member ignored), invalid value accepted no-throw as a pre-157 build must, overflowX 0 both classes, zero failed requests. Partial: the member-read and TypeError paths need a 157+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts roll-call control integrity and records the enum-check outcome; all constructor promises claimed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; read/ignored/bad states pair emerald/charcoal/rose with full text; the button that previously nested an invisible light-on-light <code> was caught in screenshot review and fixed to plain text.

accessibility.rationale: Roll-call is a list with per-item text states (not color-only), native buttons, one polite output for the enum check, verdict as styled text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×900 after the fix: 0px horizontal overflow, cards wrap, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the read + TypeError paths on Chrome 157+
openQuestions.detail: On a 157+ or WebTransportDatagramsReadableType-flagged build, the subject row should flip to "read by the constructor", the verdict to the opt-in-reaches-stream-setup message, and the invalid-value check should throw TypeError; the conformance route should then read 6 pass / 1 blocked.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Meaningful single live region per surface; textual state, not color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each member card prints its state as text; the enum-check result is one polite output; the verdict paragraph carries the full conclusion.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive card list without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid/flex with wrapping and intrinsic sizing instead of fixed columns; let long tokens break.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Roll-call is a single-column grid of cards with word-break on the 24-char member names; 0px overflow measured at 360px.

summary: Dictionary roll-call with self-invalidating controls plus the invalid-enum cross-check. Build iteration caught two real defects via screenshot review (allowPooling is not converted by Chromium 141 — control switched to serverCertificateHashes; an invisible code-in-button styling trap) and the page was re-verified after the fix with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): controls hold, honest ignored verdict, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
